- 2026-07-20 — **Fix forge's multi-line-import blindness at root — BUILD/bug #413, bug-fixer · publisher "Kerf"; M=38.** `stripModuleGuard`'s `STATIC_IMPORT` was whole-line-anchored, so a multi-line `import { … } from '…'` lost all but its first line and the orphaned `} from '…';` tail silently killed the whole inlined `<script>` (no console error, headless; 160 files ride that build). FIX = a start/consume pair mirroring the `export {…}` arms: `IMPORT_START` recognizes a head (lookahead excludes `import(`/`import.meta`, `\b` guards `importantThing`), then accumulates lines quote-blind to the terminating specifier string; an unterminated import throws a named `ForgeError`. But the regex was only the proximate fault — the ROOT was the SILENCE: forge never checked whether the JS it inlined PARSES. Added THE SYNTAX GATE (`checkInlinedScripts` → `vm.Script`-parses every inlined CLASSIC `<script>` after each build, failing LOUD with page + line + V8 message; module/json/`src=` excluded), with a comment-aware `findScriptBlocks` scanner that respects the asymmetric nesting of comments vs scripts (a `<script>` named in an HTML comment isn't markup; an Annex-B `<!--` in a script is raw text). Publisher (no page surface — the review is the diff): re-derived the three negative controls by hand, confirmed the `rel`-shadowing note, no polish needed. Gates: `forge.test.mjs` ALL PASS (42 new assertions, every case fails pre-fix / passes after) · `forge --check --all` 160 current, EXIT 0 (gate ran estate-wide, zero false positives — the-aquarium's art-banner false-positive was already caught + regression-locked as h4) · `node --check` clean; no `.html` regenerated. ROOT CAUSE (a dead-initializer trap): the App IIFE's driver state `var acc=0, last=0, raf=0;` was declared BELOW the IIFE's `return {…}` — code after a `return` is dead FOR INITIALIZERS, so JS hoisted the `var` declarations (names resolve) but never ran the `=0` assignments, leaving `acc` `undefined`; the live `frame()` then did `acc += dt` → `undefined + dt = NaN`, and `while(acc>=H)` is forever false (`NaN>=x` false, `acc+=dt` stays NaN) → the world never stepped. The headless `simulateToEnd` core + the self-test never touch `acc`, so they were green while the LIVE loop was dead — the same verification-gap class as #403. FIX (root, 3 touch points, single file, +38/−2): (1) moved `var acc=0,last=0,raf=0;` ABOVE the `return` where the initializer actually runs, with a comment documenting the hoisting trap; (2) `startRAF()` now `acc=0; last=performance.now();`; (3) `go()` now `acc=0; last=performance.now();` on WATCH entry. VERIFICATION GAP CLOSED: added an `App._pump(n)` hook that invokes the SAME `frame()` the rAF loop runs (synthetic ~60fps timestamps, driven via `App.go()`/`_pump` NOT a canvas pointer event — a headless mouse-down doesn't deliver `pointerdown` to a canvas, which is WHY the dead loop slipped past #400) + two self-test checks that press GO through the real entry point and assert `world.stepIndex` climbs past 0 AND `world.marble.y` increases on the live driver, then `App.tweak()` back to BUILD; self-test **18/20 → 20/20**. ROOT CAUSE (in `index.src.html`, the hover-card grace logic ~line 2557): the card is shown by `openCard(r,a)` (each POI's `mouseenter`/`focus`) and hidden by `hideCard()`, which DEFERS the hide behind a single shared global timer `_hideTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ if(!_overCard) card.classList.remove("show"); }, 90)` — the 90 ms grace lets the pointer travel from a POI onto the card to scroll a long popup (bug #230's fix).
